"B"

                     May 10th.,       38.
P.

See below.

Hand Grenade explosion on Avenue Road.
Detectives have continued enquiries in the vicinity
of the explosion, but have been unable to obtain any
further information.
    It is possible that the grenade was thrown with the
intentio.. of intimidating the owners of Repair Garages
near the spot, detectives having noted Japanese owned
motor cars being repaired there on several occasions
in recent weeks, but enquiries there have failed to
confirm this.
    At 7.0am. on 10/5/38 a telephone message was
received from the Paulun Hospital reporting that the
female named Tsih Zung Sz had died there at 9am. same
date as a result of the injuries she had received in the
bombing.
    The body has been removed to the Public Mortuary
pending an inquest which will be held on 11/5/38.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / SPECIAL BRANCH / 11 MAY 1938）

爱文义路手榴弹爆炸案。
侦探继续在爆炸现场附近进行调查，但未能获得任何进一步的信息。
    手榴弹可能是为了恐吓该地点附近的汽车修理厂车主而投掷的，因为侦探注意到最近几周有几辆日本拥有的汽车在那里修理，但对此处的调查未能证实这一点。
    1938年5月10日上午7时，接到宝隆医院电话报告称，名为翟陈毛（Tsih Zung Sz）的女子于同日早上9时因在爆炸中受伤在该院死亡。
    尸体已移送公共停尸房，等待将于1938年5月11日举行的验尸审讯。

Hand Grenade explosion on Avenue Road.

At 7-53pm. on 7/5/38 a telephone message was
received at Sinza Station from C.P.C. 2025 reporting that
in a garbage bin
a bomb had exploded/off Avenue Road West of Carter Road and
that several persons had been injured.

S.F.B. Emergency Ambulance was called, and all
available men under Inspector Perkins, Officer i/c,
attended immediately. The Reserve Unit under Assistant
Commissioner Fairburn and C/Inspector Lovell also
attended the scene.

The following persons were transferred to the Paulun
Hospital by Ambulance:-

(1) Tsih Zung Sz(翟陳毛 ), m/female, aged 44, native of
Chingkiang, residing No.6 Kyung Yih Li, Kaifeng Road.
Doctor's Certificate reads:" Wound on spine, fragment
not extracted. Wound on buttock, not extracted. Serious"

(2) Tsih Ying Sung(翟慶生 ), aged 52, Chingkiang,
Earthenware dealer, No. 6 Kyung Yih Li, Kaifeng Road.
Doctor's chit reads:-" Wound on lower right arm and on
right lower leg." Not detained.

The 1st. and 2nd are husband and wife.

(3) Peu Ah Yoong(潘阿榮 ), aged 32, native of Pootung,
M/Carpenter, residing 7 Taku Road.
Doctor's chit reads:-"Wound on right thigh, fragment still
inside. Not serious". Detained in Hospital.

The scene of the explosion is a piece of vacant land
off Avenue Road, South side, about 200 yards West of
Carter Road, there being two garages on this land, each
used to house a privately owned motor car. An S.M.C.
Dust-bin is also inside this vacant land, which is

爱文义路手榴弹爆炸案。

1938年5月7日下午7时53分，新闸路巡捕房接到中央巡捕房2025号警员电话报告称，在卡特路西面爱文义路旁的一个垃圾箱内发生炸弹爆炸，数人受伤。

消防队紧急救护车被召往现场，由负责人珀金斯督察率领的所有可用警力立即赶赴现场。由费尔伯恩助理总监和洛弗尔首席督察率领的后备队也赶到了现场。

以下人员由救护车送往宝隆医院：-

(1) 翟陈毛（Tsih Zung Sz），女，44岁，镇江籍，住开封路庆余里6号。
医生证明书写道：“脊柱伤口，碎片未取出。臀部伤口，未取出。伤势严重”

(2) 翟庆生（Tsih Ying Sung），52岁，镇江人，陶器商，住开封路庆余里6号。
医生便条写道：-“右前臂和右小腿伤口。”未留院观察。

第1和第2项为夫妻关系。

(3) 潘阿荣（Peu Ah Yoong），32岁，浦东籍，木匠，住大沽路7号。
医生便条写道：-“右大腿伤口，碎片仍在体内。不严重”。留院观察。

爆炸现场是爱文义路南侧、卡特路西面约200码处的一块空地，该空地上有两个车库，各用于停放一辆私人汽车。工部局的一个垃圾箱也位于这块空地内，该空地

1/sheet 2.

backed by a low wall, and would be a Cul-de-sac but for
a short lane running behind the lock-up garages and the
wall.

An examination showed a small hole in the cement
to the West side of the dust-bin, numerous dents in the
low wall and in an old motor car parked on the land. Near
the scene of the explosion were found two wooden splinters,
similar to that of bombs of the "Potato Masher" type. Six
cast-iron fragments were also found.

C.P.C. 2025 when questioned stated that he had been
on duty at the corner of Carter Road and Avenue Road and
that he had run to the scene when he heard the explosion.
He had seen the injured persons sitting or lying on the
pavement and had then called the Station by telephone.

C.D.S. 72 and the undersigned visited the Paulun
Hospital and questioned the injured persons, but they
were unable to give any useful information, they having
been injured when passing the scene of the explosion.

The wall at the rear of the Dust-bin is the North
boundary of the Hu Kwang(沪光) Middle School, Lane
41, No.48-50 Carter Road. This School was visited by
detectives and the Principal, Mr. Hieu Sah Ching(許石青)
was questioned, the following information being obtained:-

About 200 students are enrolled there, their ages
being between 12 years and 20 years. Only seven students
page_data.zh:
杂项编号 193/38。

1/第2页。

背面有一堵矮墙，除了锁闭式车库和墙后的一条短巷外，本应是一条死胡同。

检查显示，垃圾箱西侧的水泥地面上有一个小洞，矮墙和停在空地上的一辆旧汽车上有许多凹痕。在爆炸现场附近发现了两块木屑，类似于“土豆捣碎器”型手榴弹的部件。还发现了六块铸铁碎片。

经询问，中央巡捕房2025号警员称，他当时正在卡特路与爱文义路拐角处执勤，听到爆炸声后跑向现场。他看到伤者坐在或躺在人行道上，随后通过电话向巡捕房报告。

刑事侦缉处72号警员及本人走访了宝隆医院并询问了伤者，但他们无法提供任何有用信息，因为他们是在经过爆炸现场时受伤的。

垃圾箱后面的墙是卡特路48-50号41弄沪光中学的北边界。侦探走访了该校，并询问了校长许石青（Hieu Sah Ching）先生，获得如下信息：-

该校约有200名学生注册，年龄在12岁至20岁之间。只有七名学生

reside on the premises.

A window on the first floor, about 18 feet from the
ground, was broken, either by fragments of the grenade of
by the concussion. No persons were injured inside the
School.

The Principal was questioned, but was un-able to
give any information which would suggest that the missile
was thrown with the intention of intimidating him or any
of his staff. He states that he has not received any
threatening letters and that he does not deal in politics.

There are nine tenants in the School buildings, as
follows:-

(1) Sung Poh You( 陳福之 ), Clerk employed in the
Central Savings Society.
(2) Bang Kyung Meu( 彭新務 ), Analyst, temporarily
unemployed.
(3) Tseu Sing Ziang( 周新祥 ), Fur Store Assistant,
Henan Road.
(4) Liang Tsang Sz( 梁昌氏 ), m/female, husband at
present absent in Hong Kong, being employed as a cook.
(5) Wong Bein Ling( 黃培林 ), Clerk attached to Louza
Police Station.
(6) Yih Zung Sz( 葉宗氏 ), m/female, independant.
(7) Lieu Poh Yien( 劉博淵 ), Clerk employed in Central
Bank of China.
(8) Wang Kyung Zang( 黃慶長 ), Clerk employed in the
Mercantile Bank of India.
(9) Liang Yung Seu( 梁永秀 ), Clerk employed in A.P.C.

一楼的一扇窗户（距地面约18英尺）破碎，可能是被手榴弹碎片击中或因冲击波所致。校内无人受伤。

经询问校长，但他无法提供任何表明投掷物意在恐吓他或其任何教职员工的线索。他表示未收到任何恐吓信，且不参与政治活动。

校舍内有九名租户，如下：-

(1) 陈福之（Sung Poh You），中央储蓄会职员。
(2) 彭新务（Bang Kyung Meu），化验师，暂时失业。
(3) 周新祥（Tseu Sing Ziang），河南路皮货店店员。
(4) 梁昌氏（Liang Tsang Sz），女，丈夫目前在香港，受雇为厨师。
(5) 黄培林（Wong Bein Ling），罗致巡捕房附属职员。
(6) 叶宗氏（Yih Zung Sz），女，无业。
(7) 刘博渊（Lieu Poh Yien），中国银行职员。
(8) 黄庆长（Wang Kyung Zang），印度商业银行职员。
(9) 梁永秀（Liang Yung Seu），A.P.C.（原文如此，可能指某机构缩写）职员。

All of these persons were questioned, but could not
supply any information likely to assist in investigations.
Despite thorough enquiries on the scene, no witnesses
to the actual bombing could be found, and the motive is
still obscure, although it is possible that the object
was to intimidate the Principal of the School, for some
reason not disclosed by him.

REPORT    Date July 3, 1938.
Subject (in full) Extract from "Ta Mei Pao" dated June 29.

Made by D.S. Pitts.    Forwarded by A. Logan asst.

In regard to the contents of the attached extract
from "Ta Mei Pao" dated June 29, the official version of
the French Police is as follows:
"At 8.30 p.m. June 28, 1938 a cigarette tin containing
explosives was found in front of the Seng Tai Shen
Cigarette and Exchange Shop, 47 Rue Voisin. It had not
exploded and was removed by the French Police. It is
believed to have been placed in the position where it
was discovered for purposes of threatening the Ta Chang
Hong Shop, 6 Shung Yu Li, Rue Voisin, which sells
goods of Japanese origin. This shop is next to the
above mentioned Cigarette and Exchange Shop."

Ta Mei Pao and other local newspapers :-    29 JUNE 1933  P.M.

HAND GRENADE FOUND ON HWA SHING ROAD, FRENCH CONCESSION

At 8.20 p.m. yesterday, a man in ragged
clothing placed an object having the shape of a cigarette
box near a drain in front of the Sung Tai Zung Cigarette
Shop (森泰盛烟纸店), No. 47 Zung Yui Li (众裕里), Hwa
Shing Road (华成路) in the French Concession.  Questioned
by pedestrians who saw him doing it, the man said that he
had found it near the doors of the Van Yui Bean Sauce Shop
(万豫酱园), Hwa Shing Road.    He then disappeared.
An Annamite policeman in the vicinity arrived
and found that it was a manufactured hand grenade.  The
missile was removed.

D.S. Poll

《大美报》及其他本地报纸：    1933年6月29日 下午

法租界华盛路发现手榴弹

昨晚8时20分，一名衣衫褴褛的男子在法租界华盛路众裕里47号森泰盛烟纸店门前的阴沟附近放置了一个形状像香烟盒的物体。当被目睹此举的路人询问时，该男子称他在华盛路万豫酱园门口附近发现了该物体。随后他消失了。
附近的一名安南（越南）警察赶到，发现那是一枚制式手榴弹。该投掷物已被移除。

D.S. Poll

During the 2/8/38, a report w received from
Mr. A.R. Fletcher Analyst of the E Dept., relating
to the fragments of the bomb remov for examination,
on which is recorded the following

ANALYSIS

The fragments were stained ye w. The stains
were soluble in caustic soda and s m sulphide and
gave specific tests for arsenic.

A further portion gave the re tion for potassium.

Although the evidence is not lly conclusive
it points to the fact that the expl ive used was the
usual arsenic sulphide-potassium ch rate mixture.

It is strange that the contai could not be found
but it must be emphasised that ars c sulphide, pota-
ssium chlorate, broken glass, powd d old metal if wra-
pped tightly in paper and tied secu ly will explode
when thrown on to a hard surface.

华懋饭店及周边地区。

1938年7月30日发生在外滩19号华懋饭店 premises 相邻狭窄弄堂内的爆炸案。

1938年7月31日和8月1日期间，在事故现场及周边地区继续进行了调查，但未能查明任何可能揭示向华懋饭店投掷炸弹的正确原因或投掷者身份的新情况。

（批注：特科副本）
（批注：HP!）
1938年8月2日，收到工程部化验师 A.R. Fletcher 先生关于移除供检验的炸弹碎片的报告，记录如下

分析

碎片染有黄色污渍。这些污渍可溶于苛性钠和硫化铵，并显示出砷的特异性反应。

另一部分样品显示出钾的反应。

虽然证据并非完全确凿，但它指向这样一个事实，即所使用的炸药是常见的硫化砷-氯酸钾混合物。

奇怪的是未能找到容器，但必须强调的是，如果将硫化砷、氯酸钾、碎玻璃、粉末状旧金属紧紧包裹在纸中并牢固捆扎，当投掷到坚硬表面时会发生爆炸。

（印章：1938年10月18日）
（签名：V. Tick）
